intro.t: Good afternoon. My name's Maya. And your names are?
Thank you. First of all, we'd like to know something about you.

turns.q: Where are you from?

stages.t: Where am I from? Funchal, and I'm really proud of it!
I was born here, and I've lived in the same street all my life.
Mainly because my grandparents built our house.
Even though I'd like to live abroad one day, I think I'll always come back.

turns.q: What's your home like?

stages.t: Oh, I really like my home.
It's a small flat near the market.
Mainly because I can walk to school in five minutes.

turns.q: Who are you most like in your family?

stages.t: Ha! Everybody says I'm just like my dad.
We're both very talkative, and we both love football.
For example, last Sunday we watched Marítimo together and shouted at the TV for ninety minutes!
However, I'm much tidier than he is, so my mum says I'm her favourite.

turns.q: Do you go on holiday with your family?

stages.t: Yes, I love family holidays.
Every summer we go to Porto Santo.
Mainly because the beach there is amazing.

turns.q: Who do you spend time with at the weekend?

stages.t: At the weekend? Mostly with my friends, and I absolutely love it.
We usually meet in the centre on Saturday afternoon.
Mainly because it's the only time we're not busy with homework.
But on Sundays I always have lunch with my grandparents.

turns.q: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

stages.t: Yes, I have one little brother.
He's eight, and his name is Rodrigo.
For example, yesterday he used my phone without asking!

turns.q: What's your city like?

stages.t: My city? Oh, I love it! I find Funchal very beautiful.
What I like most about it is that it's right next to the sea.
Especially in the evenings, when my friends and I walk along the seafront.
Although it has become more crowded with tourists, it still feels like home.

turns.q: Where's the best place to go with friends in your city?

stages.t: Oh, I love the Lido.
The thing I love about it is the swimming pool.
Especially in summer, when it's very hot.

turns.q: Do you travel far every day?

stages.t: Far? Oh yes, quite far, unfortunately!
The thing is, I live up in Monte, but my school is in the centre.
For example, yesterday the bus took forty minutes!
However, I've become more used to it, and now I just listen to music on the way.

turns.q: Is there anything you'd change about your city?

stages.t: Hmm, let me think… I'd like better buses.
The thing is, they're often late.
Mainly because there aren't enough drivers.

turns.q: Do you prefer going by car or by public transport?

stages.t: To be honest, I'm not a big fan of buses, so I prefer the car.
The thing I love about it is that it's much faster.
Especially on Saturdays, when my dad drives me to football training.
The only problem is that it's worse for the environment.

turns.q: How much time do you spend listening to music?

stages.t: Oh, I love music!
I listen to it every day, for about two hours.
Mainly because it helps me relax.

turns.q: What do you usually do in the evenings?

stages.t: In the evenings? Honestly, it depends on the day.
Most evenings I do my homework first, and then I play football in the park.
Mainly because my mum doesn't let me go out before I finish.
Although I'm usually tired by nine, I always find time to chat with my friends.

turns.q: Do you get a lot of homework?

stages.t: Oh yes, too much!
We get homework almost every day.
Especially in maths, which is my hardest subject.

turns.q: Is there something you do every week after school?

stages.t: Yes, and it's my favourite part of the week!
Every Tuesday and Thursday I have football training at the club.
For example, last week we practised penalties for an hour, and I scored all of mine.
The only problem is that I get home really late, so I do my homework on the bus.

turns.q: Are you a morning person?

stages.t: Not at all! I hate getting up early.
I usually get up at seven, and I'm always sleepy.
Mainly because I go to bed too late.

turns.q: What are you going to do this weekend?

stages.t: This weekend? I'm really looking forward to it!
On Saturday I'm going to walk the levada in Ribeiro Frio with my cousins.
Mainly because my cousin is visiting from Lisbon, and she's never seen it.
However, if it rains, we'll probably just watch films at home.

turns.q: How do you usually spend your Sundays?

stages.t: Oh, I love Sundays!
I usually have lunch with my grandparents.
Especially in winter, when my grandmother makes soup.

turns.q: Have you seen a good film recently?

stages.t: Yes, I have, and I absolutely loved it!
Last Friday I saw a new science fiction film at the cinema with my friends.
Mainly because the special effects were amazing.
Even though it was nearly three hours long, I didn't get bored at all.

turns.q: Do you play computer games?

stages.t: Not really, I'm not a big fan.
I play sometimes with my brother.
Mainly because I prefer being outside.

turns.q: How much time do you spend listening to music?

stages.t: Oh, loads of time! I can't live without music.
I listen to it for about two hours a day, usually on my headphones.
For example, I always listen to music on the bus to school.
However, my parents say I should spend more time listening to them!

turns.q: Have you been to any parties recently?

stages.t: Yes, I have, and it was great!
Last Saturday I went to my best friend's birthday party.
Especially because we danced all evening.

turns.q: Is there anything you really don't like doing?

stages.t: Hmm, let me think… Yes, I really hate tidying my room.
My mum makes me do it every Saturday morning.
Mainly because I never throw anything away.
But I must admit, it feels great when it's finished.

turns.q: What kind of food do you like?

stages.t: Oh, I love food!
My favourite is espetada with bolo do caco.
Especially when we eat it at a family party.

turns.q: Is there a sport or hobby you enjoy?

stages.t: Definitely! I'm crazy about surfing.
I've been surfing for two years, usually in Porto da Cruz, on the north coast.
Mainly because being in the sea makes me feel free.
Although the water is quite cold in winter, I still go almost every weekend.

turns.q: Do you prefer individual or team sports?

stages.t: Hmm, I prefer team sports.
I play volleyball at school.
Mainly because I like playing with my friends.

turns.q: What's the most popular sport in your country?

stages.t: Oh, that's easy! Football, of course.
Almost everyone in Portugal supports a team, and here in Madeira most people support Marítimo or Nacional.
For example, when there's a big match, the cafés in Funchal are completely full.
However, sports like surfing and running are becoming more popular too.

turns.q: Do you ever watch sport on TV?

stages.t: Yes, sometimes.
I watch football with my dad on Sundays.
Especially when Portugal is playing.

turns.q: Is there a sport you'd like to try?

stages.t: Yes! I'd love to try paragliding.
You can do it here in Madeira, from the mountains above Calheta.
Mainly because I'd love to see the island from the sky.
Even though it looks a bit scary, I think it would be amazing.

turns.q: Do you do any sport at school?

stages.t: Yes, we do.
We have PE twice a week.
Especially basketball, which is my favourite.

turns.q: Do you have any good memories of school?

stages.t: Oh yes, lots of them!
My best memory is a school trip to Porto Moniz when I was ten.
For example, we swam in the natural pools, and our teacher fell in with all her clothes on!
Although it was years ago, we still laugh about it.

turns.q: What's your favourite subject?

stages.t: Oh, I love English!
We have English four times a week.
Mainly because I can understand my favourite songs.

turns.q: Is there anything you'd like to study in the future?

stages.t: Yes, I've already thought about it a lot.
I'd like to study marine biology at university.
The thing is, I grew up next to the sea, and I want to protect it.
However, I might have to study in Lisbon, so I'd miss my family.

turns.q: Have you ever had a part-time job?

stages.t: No, not yet.
But I sometimes help in my aunt's café.
Especially in summer, when there are lots of tourists.

turns.q: Would you rather work for a big or a small company?

stages.t: Hmm, that's a difficult question… I think a small one.
In a small company, everyone knows each other.
Mainly because I'd feel more like part of a team.
On the other hand, a big company would probably pay more!

turns.q: What do you do in the break at school?

stages.t: Oh, I love the break!
I usually talk with my friends in the playground.
Especially after a difficult test.

turns.q: Do you enjoy long journeys?

stages.t: Long journeys? Not really, to be honest.
When we fly to Lisbon, it's only an hour and a half, but the waiting feels endless.
For example, last summer our flight was four hours late.
However, if I have my headphones and a good playlist, I can survive anything.

turns.q: Which country would you most like to visit?

stages.t: Oh, I'd love to go to Japan.
I really want to see Tokyo.
Mainly because I love Japanese food.

turns.q: What's the most interesting place you've travelled to?

stages.t: Definitely London! It was amazing.
I went there last year with my parents for five days.
For example, we spent a whole day in the Natural History Museum and still didn't see everything.
Even though it rained almost every day, I'd go back tomorrow.

turns.q: What do you like doing on holiday?

stages.t: I love going to the beach.
I usually go swimming with my friends.
Especially in August, when the water is warm.

turns.q: Do you enjoy travelling?

stages.t: Absolutely! It's one of my favourite things.
I've visited six countries so far, mostly with my family.
Mainly because I love trying new food and hearing new languages.
The only problem is that it's very expensive to travel from an island.

turns.q: Have you ever been on a plane?

stages.t: Yes, many times.
I usually fly to Lisbon with my family.
Mainly because my aunt lives there.
